claim_verdicts.claim: C1: spectrum = r^2 dominant + r(d_in+d_out-2r) equal bulk + zeros (r=2, d_out=6 -> 4 / 36 / rest)
claim_verdicts.evidence: No three-cluster structure in any of the 52 runs x 2 checkpoints. Data-driven dominant count of the raw update-field Jacobian Re eig(H) is d_out=6 (not r^2=4) at the end of training in 27/29 L=4 runs with k<=8 (all T, beta, gain, reset, surrogate, readout; exceptions detach_reset and center_features give 1), and the 6 values are exactly equal copies of lambda_1(Sigma_a) (base: 6 x 0.8453, next 0.2817 = lambda_2(Sigma_a)). For H_o the count is 2 (19/29 runs) or 6 (T=1, beta=0, k=1), never 4. H_o has full rank (zero fraction 0-1% for k<=8; the 5.6% at T=1 is rank deficiency of binary features) and the 'bulk' is a continuous power-law-like decay (figure e3_snn_hyper_spectra.png); sym(H) has 45-55% negative eigenvalues in every condition.

claim_verdicts.claim: C2: dominant/bulk ratio == L (uniform init) or Theta(L)
claim_verdicts.evidence: At L=4 (base) ratio_paper(H_o)=5.4+-0.7, ratio_split=2.8+-0.9, coherence=1.79+-0.07 (end). Depth grid (seed 0): coherence(H_o) vs L has slope 0.49-0.66 (k=4,T>=4; k=1,T=16), 0.00-0.11 for T=1 (any k) and for k=25 (any T): values 1.0-1.2 at L=2, 1.7-2.8 at L=4, 3.1-3.5 at L=6 in the best case, never L. ratio_paper(H_o) grows with L only mildly and T-dependently (k=4: 3.2/4.9/6.4 for T=16, 2.9/4.2/4.8 for T=4, 3.2/4.4/4.4 for T=1); ratio_split shows no systematic L dependence (1.9-4.3). Depth alone does not set the ratio: T and k change it as much as L does.

claim_verdicts.claim: C3: H = H_o + H_f with H_f ~ residual -> 0, so H -> H_o during training
claim_verdicts.evidence: ||H_f||_F/||H_o||_F stays at 0.92-1.03 at the end of training in every L=4 condition except hard reset (0.64), T=1 (0.29) and beta=0 (0.35), although the residual fell 9x (loss 1.4 -> 0.018). asymmetry(H)=1.06-1.10 (base, end). The residual-weighted part of H does decay: the hidden diagonal blocks of H shrink by the same factor as the residual (0.104 vs 0.110, both seeds), but H_o contains hidden-layer surrogate Gauss-Newton terms that never appear in the block-upper-triangular H, so H_f does not vanish. Extreme case detach_reset=True: ||H||/||H_o|| = 0.037 at the end (H_f ~ -H_o): H_o scale x25 (lambda_max 164 vs 6.9) while H barely changes (lambda_max(sym H) 3.6 vs 1.75).

claim_verdicts.claim: C4: the dominant/bulk gap is caused by depth, not by data-covariance imbalance
claim_verdicts.evidence: For H (update-field Jacobian) the top cluster is the readout block I_{d_out} (x) Sigma_a (exact in all 104 evaluations) i.e. the uncentred second moment of the spike-rate features: a data/feature-covariance mechanism re-created by the nonlinearity from perfectly whitened inputs. It is governed by spike statistics: readout-block top eigenvalue at init 0.002 / 0.42 / 2.38 for gain x0.5 / x1 / x2 (mean rate 0.08 / 0.21 / 0.35, ||mu||^2/tr M 0.06 / 0.43 / 0.57), and it collapses when the readout features are centred (0.845 -> 0.156 at end; n_dom(Re H) 6 -> 1). For H_o a depth-dependent coherent part exists (coherence slope ~0.5 in L when T>=4, k<=4) but it is absent at T=1 or k=25, so the gap is not caused by depth alone.

claim_verdicts.claim: C5: GD preserves balancedness so the ratio stays == L during training
claim_verdicts.evidence: No balanced init in this experiment (kaiming only). Observed drift between init and 400 Adam steps at base: coherence 1.88 -> 1.79, ratio_split 2.06 -> 2.82, ratio_paper 5.7 -> 5.4, lambda_max(H_o) 2.8 -> 6.9: the ratios are not conserved, but Adam is not GD.

claim_verdicts.claim: Coherence bound lambda_max(H_o) <= L max_l lambda_max(B_ll), saturated (== L) in the paper's linear case
claim_verdicts.evidence: coherence(H_o) in [1.00, 3.72] in all runs (max 3.72 at L=6, k=4, T=4 init), i.e. bound always satisfied and never saturated (would be 2/4/6).

claim_verdicts.claim: P1 (theory notes): C_SNN(L) < L; question whether it grows linearly with slope < 1 or saturates
claim_verdicts.evidence: Slopes of coherence(H_o) vs L (L=2,4,6; end): 0.58 (k=4,T=4), 0.49 (k=4,T=16), 0.52 (k=1,T=16), 0.04-0.05 (k=1/4, T=1 or T=4 with k=1), 0.00-0.11 (k=25). Sub-linear growth that needs T>=4 and moderate k; coherence ~1 (no cross-layer coherence at all) for T=1 and for k=25.

claim_verdicts.claim: P2 (theory notes): dominant count tracks d_out, top eigenvectors live in W_L, ratio governed by ||mu||^2/lambda(Cov_a)
claim_verdicts.evidence: Holds exactly for H: top of Re eig(H) = d_out copies of lambda_1(Sigma_a) (27/29 runs), readout-block top = max Re eig(H) at the end in 27/29 runs, collapses under centring and scales with the spike rate. Only partially for H_o: n_dom(H_o)=2 at L=4 (6 at L=2 or T=1), top-6 eigenvector energy in W_L only 0.13-0.22 at the end (0.20-0.55 at init), and lambda_max(H_o) survives centring (7.99 vs 6.86) because it comes from a coherent hidden-layer direction, not from the readout block.

claim_verdicts.claim: P3 (theory notes): surrogate slope k changes only an overall scale (H ~ k^2); counts/coherence are k-independent
claim_verdicts.evidence: Scale is NOT ~k^2. For k in {1,2,4,8}: lambda_max(H_o) 2.1/2.7/2.8/3.0 (init), 3.4/5.3/6.9/7.1 (end), trace(H_o) 28/49/70/92 (end); then an explosion at k=25 (lambda_max(H_o) 1.7e6 init, 4.9e4 end). Log-log fits over all k give exponents 3.7/2.6 (lambda_max H_o, init/end, R^2 0.63/0.67), 2.8/2.3 (sym H), 2.9/2.4 (max Re eig H), 3.2/2.3 (trace H_o) but the fits are poor because the dependence is flat-then-explosive. Per-block: readout block exponent 0.00 (exactly k-independent), W3 (1 surrogate factor) 0.75/1.19, W2 2.38/2.07, W1 4.67/3.45 -- roughly k^(1.2 x number of surrogate factors), not k^(2 x), because the fraction of (sample,time,neuron) inside the surrogate window scales as k^-0.9. Structure for k<=8: n_dom(Re H)=6, neg fraction 0.45-0.49, ||H_f||/||H_o|| 0.6-1.0 nearly k-invariant; coherence(H_o) drifts 2.1 -> 1.7 (exponent -0.23, R^2 0.82) and ratio_paper 6.5 -> 4.4; at k=25 everything changes (coherence 1.0, ratio_paper 26, zero fraction 0.22, loss 0.45 = training fails).

claim_verdicts.claim: Theory notes section 5: SNN update-field Jacobian is block upper-triangular; eig(H) = union of diagonal-block eigs; readout block = I (x) Sigma_a
claim_verdicts.evidence: Over all 104 full-H evaluations (every T, k, beta, reset, detach_reset, surrogate, readout, gain, centring, L in {2,4,6}): max Frobenius norm of the strictly lower-left layer blocks = 0.0 exactly; eigenvalue-union error <= 4.5e-15 relative; readout block vs I kron Sigma_a relative error = 0.0 (Sigma of centred features when center_features=True); max |Im eig(H)| / max Re eig(H) <= 0.026; H_o exactly symmetric.

claim_verdicts.claim: (ii) T acts like extra depth (coherence/ratio increase with T)
claim_verdicts.evidence: Scale grows with T (lambda_max(H_o) 0.46 -> 3.3 init, 2.4 -> 9.9 end for T=1..16; block exponents T^0.6-0.8 at init). Coherence(H_o) at end: 1.24 (T=1), 1.72, 2.36, 1.79, 1.83 -- rises from T=1 to T=4 then saturates; ratio_paper 4.2 -> 5.5 and ratio_split 2.4 -> 3.0 change by < 30% from T=1 to T=16. T is necessary for depth to produce coherence (T=1: coherence ~1.0-1.2 at every L) but T itself is not 'extra depth'. asymmetry(H) at end grows strongly with T: 0.37, 0.57, 0.88, 1.08, 1.17; ||mu||^2/tr M grows 0.33 -> 0.52.

claim_verdicts.claim: (iii) detach_reset / hard reset change the asymmetry of H
claim_verdicts.evidence: detach_reset=True: asymmetry(H) 0.885 (init) / 1.117 (end) vs base 0.969+-0.010 / 1.083+-0.019 -- unchanged; but it multiplies the surrogate Gauss-Newton scale by 20-25x (lambda_max(H_o) 54.6 / 164 vs 2.8 / 6.9), kills cross-layer coherence of H_o (1.04) and makes H_f ~ -H_o (||H||/||H_o|| = 0.037). reset=hard: asymmetry 0.843 / 0.696 (end: -35%), ||H_f||/||H_o|| 0.64, lambda_max(H_o) 3.7, coherence 2.11, higher rate 0.33. The asymmetry is generated by the temporal recurrence through the membrane leak, not by the reset path: at end asymmetry = 0.35 (beta=0), 0.69 (beta=0.5), 1.08 (beta=0.9), 1.12 (beta=0.99) and 0.37 at T=1.

claim_verdicts.claim: (iv) spike rate (init gain) controls the feature-mean spike and the dominant count
claim_verdicts.evidence: At init (seed 0): mean rate 0.082 / 0.208 / 0.354, ||mu||^2 2.4e-4 / 0.32 / 2.4, ||mu||^2/tr M 0.06 / 0.43 / 0.57, readout-block top 0.002 / 0.42 / 2.38, lambda_max(H_o) 0.041 / 2.6 / 14.3 for gain x0.5 / x1 / x2; n_dom(Re H) 9 / 2 / 3, n_dom(H_o) 1 in all. After 400 Adam steps the rate statistics converge (rate 0.22-0.28, ||mu||^2/tr M 0.42-0.54, readout top 0.81-1.02) and n_dom(Re H) = 6 = d_out for all three gains; gain x2 trains poorly (loss 0.30) and x0.5 starts almost silent (window fraction 0.06).

claim_verdicts.claim: (v) centring the readout features collapses the feature-mean spike
claim_verdicts.evidence: Collapses in H: readout block = I kron Cov_a, top 0.138 (init) / 0.156 (end) vs 0.42 / 0.845 uncentred; max Re eig(H) 0.60 / 0.229 (vs 1.14 / 1.04); n_dom(Re H) 2 / 1 (vs 2 / 6); top-6 eigenvector energy in W_L 0.03 / 0.01. Does NOT collapse lambda_max(H_o): 2.30 / 7.99 (base 2.6 / 5.5 seed 0), n_dom(H_o)=2, coherence 1.76, ratio_split 2.97 -- the top eigenvalue of the surrogate Gauss-Newton matrix is a coherent hidden-layer direction unrelated to the feature mean. Single seed (seed-1 replicate skipped by budget).

anomalies: Surrogate-gradient explosion through the non-detached soft reset at k=25 (sigmoid, sg'(0)=k/4=6.25 > 1): |d u_t / d u_{t-1}| = |beta - theta sg'(v)| up to ~5.4 compounds over T, giving lambda_max(H_o) up to 2.0e12 (L=2,T=16, init), 3.7e12 (L=4,T=16) and 2.2e14 (L=6,T=16), ratio_split up to 1.5e7, one dominating first-layer block (coherence 1.00) and failed training (end loss 0.41-0.83 for k=25 vs 0.01-0.03 for k<=8). Real behaviour, not a bug (finite differences agree to 1e-9 at k=4; eigen-union error relative 4.5e-15 even at 1e14).

Dead network: k=25, T=1, L=6 never trains (loss 1.000 at init and end, mean rate 0.058, lambda_max(H_o)=9e-22); k=25, T=1, L=4 trains poorly (loss 0.73). Deep nets with T=1 are nearly silent at kaiming init (rate 0.058-0.097).

cluster_stats zero_count uses tol relative to max|eig|, so in the exploding regime 20-48% of H_o eigenvalues count as 'zero' (k=25) although H_o has full numerical rank elsewhere; interpret zero fractions at k=25 as a scale artefact.

Data-driven dominant count of H_o at init is seed-fragile (seed 0: 1, seed 1: 6 at base; the largest log-gap is ambiguous on a continuous spectrum); at the end both seeds give 2. ratio_split at end also varies 2x between seeds (1.96 vs 3.67).

detach_reset=True gives a 20-25x larger surrogate Gauss-Newton H_o (its top eigenvector sits entirely in W1) with no corresponding change of H; the Fisher/GN proxy used by second-order SNN methods is dominated by terms that are not in the update-field Jacobian.

readout='membrane' multiplies the readout block by the leaky-integration gain (readout-block top 4.3 / 4.0, initial loss 5.97) and gives n_dom(Re H)=14 at init; after training n_dom(Re H)=6 like the rate readout.
T=1 and beta=0 behave alike (asymmetry 0.37 / 0.35, ||H_f||/||H_o|| 0.29 / 0.35, n_dom(H_o)=6): without a leak path the update-field Jacobian is much closer to symmetric.
max |Im eig(H)| reaches 159 in absolute terms (k=25) but is <= 2.6% of max Re eig(H) in every evaluation; complex pairs are a small perturbation.
reductions_extra: Depth interaction (k in {1,4,25} x T in {1,4,16} x L in {2,4,6}) run with seed 0 only (as specified); 6 extra L=4 cells (k in {1,25} x T in {1,4,16}) were added so every (k,T) line has three L values; the k=4 line at L=4 uses the T-sweep runs.

Budget accounting: 4 other experiments shared the 4 CPUs (load 5-7), so the guard was switched to process CPU time (time.process_time) with a 60 CPU-min budget; full run = 60.9 CPU-min, 63.6 wall-min (plus a 9.8-min smoke run). The 10 skipped runs are seed-1 replicates of the beta / detach_reset / reset / surrogate / readout / gain / center_features conditions; those effects are single-seed (seed-to-seed spread at base, end: asymmetry +-0.02, coherence +-0.07, lambda_max(H_o) +-1.4, ratio_split +-0.85).
The container restarted once (usage limit) after the smoke run; the 4 full-run conditions completed before the restart were kept via --resume (identical data-collection code).
notes: No library bug found. Finite-difference check of H at base: relative errors 1.2e-9, 1.1e-9. gain_mult=1 reproduces the default kaiming init exactly.

All runs: n=256, d_in=16, width 16, setting B (r=2, d_out=6), MSE, kaiming init (gain sqrt(2) x multiplier), Adam lr 5e-3, 400 full-batch steps, float64, 1 torch thread; full H (jacfwd(jacrev)) and H_o at init and at step 400; raw non-symmetric eigenvalues of H stored in raw/*.npz (eigH_raw_re_step*, eigH_raw_im_step*) next to eig_Ho_step* and eig_symH_step*.

Base-config numbers (mean of 2 seeds; init -> end): lambda_max(H_o) 2.82 -> 6.86, lambda_max(sym H) 1.57 -> 1.75, max Re eig(H) 1.14 -> 1.04, readout-block top 0.74 -> 1.04, trace(H_o) 36 -> 70, ratio_paper 5.7 -> 5.4, ratio_split 2.1 -> 2.8, coherence 1.88 -> 1.79, n_dom(H_o) 3.5 -> 2, n_dom(Re H) 5 -> 6, zero frac(H_o) 0.006 -> 0.003, neg frac(sym H) 0.53 -> 0.49, asymmetry 0.97 -> 1.08, ||H_f||/||H_o|| 1.49 -> 0.93, mean rate 0.23 -> 0.26, ||mu||^2/tr M 0.56 -> 0.50, loss 1.39 -> 0.018.
